blocks.text: We love spending time outdoors and are passionate about the outdoors, just as you are. Decorate your favorite yard look with a Shintenchi 5 piece set. Each part of the furniture is independent and can be rearranged randomly to provide a most comfortable and relaxing leisure environment for your family and friends.

Feature:
 1.You could combine the Shintenchi 5 pcs outdoor furniture set freely according to your needs in your garden, balcony, poolside or porch.
 2. We have a variety of cushion colors for your choice.
 3. Durable PE rattan material and hand woven, keep the sofa more stable.

Specification:
 Rattan Color: Silver Gray
 Cushion Color: Blue/Red/Khaki/Royal Blue/Aegean Blue
 Steel frame material: Iron
 Rattan material: PE
 Cushion fabric: 250g polyester fabric and sponge padded
 Corner sofa dimensions: 26.6 x 26x 25 inches
 Single sofa dimensions: 24 x 24 x 25 inches
 The dimension of side table: 23.6 x 23.6 x 11.8 inches
 2 x corner sofa with Aegean blue cover 2 x single sofa with Aegean blue cover 1 x side tea table with glass top
 Notes:
 1. Ship in one boxe.
 2. Do not completely tighten the screws before you finish all the installation.
 3. Please measure the size before purchase to see if it meets your needs to avoid unnecessary trouble. (As the dimensions above were measured by hand, there may be some minor inaccuracies )
 4. The color of the cushion may vary slightly in different situation or display.
 5. Please cover the set when rain, snow or frost comes since the inner sponge is not water proof.

items.label: Sturdy&Durable
items.value: Solid metal structure make it super safe to sit in the sofa set. Added bars for the frame enhance the sturdiness and allow the sofa to support heavy people about 400lbs. Adjustable feet make it steady on uneven surfaces. PE Wicker is strong enough to survive inclement weather and guarantee the set has a long service life.Note: cushions are not water-proof, When you don' t use it, advise you to take cushions inside or buy a cover for longer service time.

items.label: Comfortable&Suitable
items.value: Including four seat cushions and four back cushions providing you with upgraded comfort. Suitable for everyone who needs great comfort. Also suitable for different scenes like poolside, backyard, garden, patio, etc.

items.label: Sectional&Separable
items.value: This sofa set includes four sofa and can be put into different configurations. You can put all of them together to make a sofa with long chaise or choose to put them separately for more people to sit in based on your own demands.

items.label: Easy Maintenance
items.value: Designed with a zipper, it's easy to take off the cushion cover and splash-proof material is easy to wash. As for the tempered glass top, you can soak the towel in clean water then to clean. For some stain that is hard to wipe off, you can use water around 100°F to soak the towel to clean.

items.label: Note
items.value: cushions are not water-proof, When you don' t use it, advise you to take cushions inside or buy a cover for longer service time.

items.label: Included Components
items.value: 2 x corner sofa /2 x single sofa /1 x table
